workshop_summary: Session 2 on harmonising replenishment across DK, SE, NO and FI: model, safety stock and pilot.

decisions.decision: Adopt one Group replenishment model with daily auto-replenishment
Norway gets a lead-time parameter override instead of a separate process
Safety stock is set centrally per category with no manual buffers, reviewed after the pilot

open_issues.issue: Choose the pilot market: Sweden or Finland

actions.action: Own the item master data cleanup across both ERPs
Find two business people to support the data cleanup
Prepare rough business cases for a Sweden and a Finland pilot
Take the pilot market decision to the steering committee
Estimate the DC impact of daily picking in Jönköping
Create a training plan for store managers on auto-replenishment
Flag the data cleanup timeline risk to the steering committee

risks.risk: The Jönköping DC cannot pick a daily order profile and there is no budget for extra pickers
The item master cleanup takes longer than 8 weeks and delays the whole timeline
Markets keep their own safety stock buffers so inventory rises instead of falling
Stores do not accept centrally set safety stock

dependencies.depends_on: Jönköping DC picking capacity or wave planning change
Business cases for Sweden and Finland
